predictions.articleTitle: Cuba vs Grenada Prediction & Match Analysis: Can La Polar Hosts Overwhelm Grenada? — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Cuba's 17-goal Group C attack and +141.0 Elo advantage are projected to carry them past a defensively fragile Grenada side in Havana.
possibilityAssessment: Cuba Home Win driven by superior Group C attacking output and +24h recovery advantage (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals backed by 100% of Grenada's and 80% of Cuba's Group C fixtures clearing 2.5 goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Grenada Counter-Attacking Goal Risk stemming from Cuba's 6 goals conceded in their last 3 group outings (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten Cuba attack tests Grenada defense conceding 2.80 per group game.

spf.comment: Both the 2:1 and 3:0 core scripts reflect Cuba's superior Elo, Group C firepower, and 3:0 reverse-fixture dominance over Grenada.

over_under.comment: All five of Grenada's Group C games and four of Cuba's five have produced three or more goals despite a lower 2.25 generic lambda total.

score.comment: 2:1 respects Grenada's recent 3:2 scoring lift against Cuba's open October games, while 3:0 repeats September's clean-sheet gap.

goals.comment: Cuba's 3.40 goals scored and Grenada's 2.80 conceded per Group C game anchor expectations around three to four total goals.

bqc.comment: Cuba led 1:0 at half-time in both their 3:0 win over Grenada and 7:1 win over Bonaire, while second-half fatigue favors a late home pull-away if tied.
